name: Sagittal
description: Divides the body into left and right halves. Forward/backward movements such as flexion and extension.

name: Frontal
description: Divides the body into front and back halves. Side-to-side movements such as abduction and adduction.

name: Transverse
description: Divides the body into upper and lower halves. Rotational movements around the longitudinal axis.
